ai_summary: Century Enka Limited announced the mandatory deduction of Tax at Source (TDS) on its recommended 110% dividend for FY2025-26, a compliance requirement under the Income Tax Act, 2025. Shareholders must proactively update their details and submit specific tax documents by August 13, 2026, to ensure the correct TDS rate is applied or to avail exemptions/DTAA benefits. A significant material impact and potential red flag for shareholders is that failure to provide valid documentation (e.g., an invalid PAN due to unlinked Aadhaar for individuals) will result in a substantially higher TDS rate of 20% or more, directly reducing their net dividend payout.
